description: Rewire codebase to Turso + Redis: create turso.h/c, redis_client.h/c, stdlib_redis.c; rewrite stdlib_db.c, stdlib_jobs.c, cmd_migrate.c; update stdlib_kv.c, stdlib_cache.c, cmd_new.c, cmd_dev.c, vek_stdlib.h/c; update tests and Makefile
steps: Update src/stdlib_kv.c with optional Redis backend
Update src/stdlib_cache.c with optional Redis backend
Update src/cmd_new.c to generate .env.example, Dockerfile, fly.toml
Update src/cmd_dev.c to check Turso env vars
Update src/vek_stdlib.c to register redis package
Update Makefile: add turso.o, redis_client.o, stdlib_redis.o
acceptance_criteria: grep -ri sqlite returns nothing in src/, tests/
findings: Discovered a GC/map rehash bug where registering the redis package after db caused db.connect to become nil. Fixed by registering redis before db in stdlib_init. One pre-existing integration test failure (stdlib_flash) due to trailing newline comparison mismatch in test runner.
